layers.name: ARCHIVAL_SEMANTIC_CLASSIFICATION
layers.pass_if: Scene boundary validated; every known marker covers a non-overlapping line span; first-person declarations, NPC claims, narrator effects, mechanical labels, and exit/status split; all contrary evidence and unknowns explicit; coverage contains no omitted archival lines.

layers.name: ORIGINAL_PROVENANCE_AUTHENTICATION
layers.pass_if: Independently verifiable original player, narrator and actual RNG/tool transcripts with consistent timestamps and immutable locators; absent proof stays UNKNOWN.

layers.name: EXTERNAL_INDEPENDENT_EDITORIAL_REVIEW
layers.pass_if: Named reviewer materially distinct from author validates sample/contradictions/marking, records signed verdict; author may not self-attest independence.

layers.name: PHASE_GATE
layers.pass_if: Required full M1/M2/M3 coverage, authorship provenance or UNKNOWN, causal links evidence graded, G28 assessment and truly independent review; gaps resolved by valid dispositions, not just asserted PASS.

rules: Original messages cannot be reconstructed by rephrasing an editorial diary.
Archive-classified marker may leave unknown historical facts; report unknown instead of fabricating.
No new XP, FV, dice, events, C06 or 2010.
Earlier historical snapshot is not current status; apply explicit later correction at its point in sequence.
Do not infer D03 from progress in a single archive scene.
No GM_HIDDEN material in output or artifact title.
note: This contract is proposed documentary procedure on design branch, not a canon/governance modification.
